Join our Easter Egg Hunt and start collecting eggs for a chance to win exclusive Avatars and Rooms. We are introducing new Avatars: Mr. Gold Whiskers, Gold Bonnie, Blue Ninja, Ernie Blue, Green Lily, Borpy, and Blue + get a 50% bonus on chip packs now!

We’ve launched three brand new chest varieties, for a total of 6 new rarities. Go to the store today and check out these awesome new chests!

[b]Pack Gifting[/b]
Pack Gifting is LIVE! Show your friends and family some generosity and gift them a pack from the store!

[b]Introducing Sloth[/b]
Recruit your friends to get your hands on this permanently exclusive avatar. He’ll be hanging out in the Recruit Chest for a limited time only, so be sure to bring your new friends along and get Sloth while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/2a87141475733dd5121854639ed964f87fe33e8b.png[/img]

Our referral program rewards you for introducing friends to HD Poker. To participate, get your Refer-a-Friend link or code and send it to your friends. In order to qualify for reward, your referee must:
[list]
[*]Have 100 hands played or,
[*]Reach level 7 or,

[/list]
Once they fulfill ANY of these requirements, you will be rewarded a Referral Chest directly added to your account! It's that easy!

[b]Good Luck and Good Vibes![/b]

notes.content:
[h2]New - [b]Outs![/b][/h2]
HD Poker now reveals everyone's "outs" during showdown! For anyone unsure what that is, an "out" is any unseen card that can change a player's hand to be the winning hand. These cards are displayed over nameplates and will update as each new street is revealed and/or when a folded player decides to show.  For brevity, some outs can appear as a solitary rank or suit.  A solitary rank means any suit with that rank will work. A solitary suit means any rank of that suit will work. In addition, we also reveal when a player has no outs ("Drawing Dead") or requires two more cards to have a better hand ("Runner Runner").  This is a toggleable feature from the topbar settings dropdown, defaulted on.

[h2]Changes / Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]MTTs are now listed as being valid for decay avoidance in various places.
[*]Player nameplates in first person view have been scaled down to ~80% of their previous size.
[*]Tournaments quickplay flyout will now list ALL upcoming MTTs, but greyed out.
[*]Shown hole cards as a part of showdown are now full brightness.
[*]Shown hole cards from folded players are now smaller and greyed so as not to detract from showdown.
[*]Showdowns will now temporarily render all non-participating players' nameplates and avatars as semi-transparnet to bring more focus to the players involved.
[*]First person hole cards have been nudged closer to center of the table.
[*]Leaderboards "Top 100" tab label changed to "Top Players" and will now list up to 500 players.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a situation where "NaN% ODDS" could appear on players not a part of an all-in showdown.
[*]Fixed the "blip" effect in SNG/TB waiting rooms when a new player joins the queue.
[*]Fixed issue with store package popups failing to render their contents after the first spawn.
[*]Fixed crash that could occur when using the DETACH CARDS feature.
[*]Fixed issue where outgoing table invites were failing to show up on (and possibly crash) your target's client.
[*]Fixed issue in contact form where keybinds were being triggered when typing a message.
[*]Fixed issue where an MTT waiting room would declare "players found, creating table..." long before it was valid to do so.
[*]Fixed issue where promotional external links could fail to redeem the promotion.
[/list]

notes.content:
[b]We've added the long-awaited Multi-Table Tournament (MTT) game mode! [/b]
True to the name, MTTs take place over many tables at once. However, unlike Shootouts, this mode will jump players to new tables as others are eliminated (or new players join) to keep a relative balance. Tables will be removed as the number of remaining players dwindle, until one table remains. Players may be able to "Late Join" an MTT for a certain period after a game has started.

[h3]Changes / New[/h3]
[list]
[*]Lobby now lists all available and upcoming quickplay STTs and MTTs
[*]Lobby now has a "Create Home Game" button
[*]You can now choose to show one -or- both of your cards at the end of a hand
[*]You can now bind your spacebar to an action
[*]Clicking on a STT/MTT game's current blinds in the top left will now reveal a blind structure flyout, including breaks
[*]Active breaks are now displayed prominently in the bottom right of a game view
[*]New gameplay setting:  "Show Flop/Turn/River", defaults ON
[*]Dealers now have a card shuffler animation on the table
[*]Dracula and Ragnarok rooms now have passive animations
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*]Table hole card now have a more exaggerrated perspective
[*]Table gifts now sit directly in front of players to avoid confusion as to who it belongs to
[*]Table cards and chip positions adjusted to accommodate new gift positions
[*]Third-person nameplate has been refactored to always show your name
[*]Namplates now flash when its your turn, and the countdown animation is slightly delayed before starting
[*]Avatars at tables and your dashboard are now thinly stroked with a semi-transparnet black line for clarity
[*]Hole cards on the table are now thinkly stroked and will now always fan outward despite table position/rotation
[*]Lobby standard game filter no longer has a blind range
[*]Lobby standard games will now list up to 50 rows per page
[*]Lobby loads are much quicker, resizing much more responsive
[*]Lobby now passively reloads itself on a periodic timer
[*]Tables you are playing at now appear with a green tint in thee Lobby
[*]A new seat effect has been added to symbolize an MTT jump-in / jump-out.
[*]Timebomb dealer no longer changes to a skeleton when the bomb explodes
[*]Lobby STT/MTT sidebars now show a list of players queued for that game
[*]Lobby STT/MTT sidebars now show the first place prize under their images
[*]Shootout final tables now have a dedicated blue/purple icon
[*]Halloween skin updated
[*]Now clamping outgoing gem trades to a player's max gem count when rounding errors push value above it
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Changes / New[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now react with a Heart/Thumb/Fire/Poop during both "Tournament Winner" and "Top Gifters" announcements
[*] You can now send table/queue invites to offline friends if they have the mobile app 
[*] Shootout announcements have been rebuilt and now offer buttons to queue immediately or spawn an info window
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tokens will now appear larger in your collection
[*] Hitting ESCAPE with focus on the side bar search tab will now switch tab to friends
[*] "Last <day of week>" changed to "<X> days ago" to mitigate confusion
[*] Attempting to tip the dealer without enough chips will now present you with a standard popup to buy more chips
[*] Shootout announcements will no longer spawn if you are already enrolled in that specific shootout
[*] "INVITE" button will now be greyed out in friends list context menus when you aren't at any tables
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash in the hand replayer when playing back spectator chat
[*] Fixed an issue where tokens or avatars could appear blank when viewing in collection, opened chests, or "Received Items" screens
[*] Fixed an issue where the Top Gifters announcement would fail to shift down any pre-existing growls
[*] Fixed an issue where logging out from the escape menu would fail to propagate your status to your online friends
[*] Fixed a memory leak related to the friend JOIN popup
[*] Fixed an issue with the numbers 11/12/13 not having the right ordinal (11st vs 11th)
[*] Fixed an issue where PSR trophies could replicate over and over in tourney replay end results screens
[*] Fixed an issue where viewing a shootout entry info window could fail to render "Advance to next table" as the prize
[/list]

notes.content:
[b]We've bumped the version up to 1.8.5 in order to stay [somewhat] syncronized with our mobile app!
[/b]
[h3]New / Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now stay in queue after closing the game - use our mobile app to notify when the game starts.
[*] You can now queue for a SnG/TB in "Shark mode" - stay anonymous until it starts.
[*] Added support for future 3-player table layouts.
[*] Recruit-a-friend rewards are now contingent on the new recruit completing specific tasks, as listed in the recruit window.
[*] Quickplay flyout will now remember the last tab you had open across sessions.
[*] Avatar collection tab now has a basic name filter to help you search.
[/list]
[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Store feature cards are now clickable everywhere, not just the price button.
[*] Incoming chat pulse icon will now only trigger if a DM window does not yet exist.
[*] Table nameplates will now display all chipstacks in white, and all [uncolored] names in default skin color.
[*] Lobby side bar will now shrink longer table names to fit.
[*] Game entry values will now generate a tooltip with the name of the token/currency required.
[*] Store is now always loaded prior to being shown, instead of cached.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where a table's room could suddenly disappear if the same room was loaded at another table.
[*] Removed a few memory leaks from the MegWheel.
[*] Opening friends list will no longer force keyboard focus to your last-used DM window.
[*] DMs from a friend will no longer be squelched if you have them muted at a table.
[*] Fixed a fatal crash related to queueing on mobile and resuming on PC/Mac.
[*] Player emotes should now properly display in hand replays.
[*] Chat with native emoji should once again be using a san-serif system font.
[*] Queuing for a shootout will now disable the option to queue again.
[/list]

[/list]

[*] Fixed issue where occasionally a tourney queue screen would start its reveal then start it again a short time after
[*] Fixed issue where the "CALL" poker action could fail to show the word "CALL"
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Changes / New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Table gifts sent from muted players will now be ignored if sent to you
[*] You can now view chips as multiples of the big blind at standard tables and/or while spectating
[*] Viewing chips as big blinds has been expanded to bets, pots, pot-wins, action buttons, and the bet slider
[*] If viewing chips as big blinds, manual bet entry is now done the same way. [i]eg., "1.5" = 1.5x <big blind>[/i]
[*] Viewing the replay of the last hand of a tournament will now spawn the final rankings screen like a live table
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sit buttons will now be set to lock mode when you don't meet the requirements of a Standard table
[*] Removed the replay button from top left header of replay windows (it did nothing)
[*] Dealer speech bubble further reduced in width at 9-player tables to prevent nameplate overlap
[*] Buy-in window for standard tables has been given a minor facelift
[*] Featured tables in the Lobby will now carry a star icon and a yellow "FEATURED" prefix to the table name
[*] Animated rooms are now labelled with the yellow film reel ribbon throughout the game
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Toggling top/bottom bars with a keybind will now properly trigger a window reflow
[*] Entering text in to the home game name/pw creation screen will no longer trigger keybindings
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Changes / New[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now trade tokens!
[*] Global and Table chat now requires you to first hit <ENTER> to activate focus on the window
[*] Global and Table chat windows now have a "clear chat" button
[*] You can now keybind all your poker actions - access from the settings [gear] dropdown
[*] All bottom bar ad banners now come with a close [X] button
[*] Settings [gear] dropdown has been trimmed down in favor of the most commonly-changed preferences
[*] You can now choose to block all incoming table/queue invites via the Settings [gear] dropdown
[*] Clicking on the Collection tab from your own profile window will now reveal your collection like any other player
[*] Trophies are now viewable from the player profile collection tab

[*] Store window is no longer modal - browse and play at the same time!
[*] Hitting ESCAPE from a modal window will now close the window
[*] All sliders in the game will now react to mousewheel changes
[*] Clicking the play button from a tourney history block will now go the the last recorded hand instead of the first

[*] Fixed an issue in chat where chat items would shift below/over the input field when maximizing
[*] Fixed issue where maximizing table chat could occasionally add invisible items to the list
[*] Fixed an issue where a pre-selected CHECK/FOLD could could get overwritten with an explicit FOLD
[*] Removed some rogue tooltips from the megawheel ticket purchase buttons

[/list]

notes.content:
[b]New[/b]

[list]
[*] PSR is now available in select SnG tourney's!  (Home games + Time Bombs do not apply).
[*] Playing PSR-enabled SnGs will now count hands towards your weekly requirements.
[*] The top three players now have their own unique PSR Tier badge
[*] A new collectible item type, [i]Trophy[/i], has been added to the game.  Earn them for winning select tournaments, or who knows what else!

[*] Levelling up will now play a sound

[*] Store is now capable of showing timers for items with an expiration date, or for new items coming soon
[*] Growls can now be dismissed with a right click.
[/list]

[list]

[*] Fixed issue where login screen errors would fail to turn the problem fields red.
[*] Fixed issue where the Forgot Password screen would fail to enable its submit button.
[/list]

notes.title: HD Poker Update 1.7 Rolling Out Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/ad023a8cf9f52d0b8a7b20becf497db63d62f734.png[/img]

[b]The HD Poker 1.7 update is now rolling out to all players! With so many additions, this is one of our most awesome updates ever![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/2241193eca4c4d9014dbcb0a8112ed2083c32614.png[/img]

[h3][b]Introducing Sit & Go’s[/b][/h3]
Play single table tournaments for great prizes and enjoy the thrill of competing for the top spot! The Sit & Go action is fast-paced and intense, with most lasting around 15 minutes. Have you perfected your Sit & Go strategies? Go for the win, and have fun while you're at it!

[h3][b]Automated Shootouts[/b][/h3]
Shootout tournaments are now automated — one click and you’re in for a chance to win some awesome stuff!

[h3][b]Gem trading added by popular request[/b][/h3]
Trade gems to your friends just as you would any other item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33473979/8a6aa021c3a951f759af96e8f239877402a8bd8a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Suspense factor during all-ins and displaying of all-in percentages[/b][/h3]
Just like on TV, we’ve added a fun suspense factor for hands that are all-in, and we’ve included the percentages for each hand pre-flop, on the flop, and on the turn! Feel the heart-racing excitement as the river card is dealt with dramatic effect! Did you hit your one-outer? Enjoy the thrill as you go for the glory!

[h3][b]Other technical details include:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Faster loading and improved connectivity
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] Many new avatars, themes, and skins!
[/list]
Get ready for our upcoming release, which will introduce Home/Private games and Time Bomb Sit & Go’s!

Thanks for playing HD Poker, and for being an awesome part of our community!

notes.title: UPDATE: Halloween Time Event and Major Updates
notes.content:
[b]Halloween[/b]
- Halloween Time is finally here!
- Introducing our Halloween Spooky Mega Pack, Chests, Avatars & Poker Rooms!

[b]Changes to Table Stakes[/b]
- Restructured the Table Stakes and Buy-Ins
- Brought back several highly requested Table Stakes

[b]Emotes[/b]
- Players can now collect Emotes in their Inventory
- Emotes can be purchased in the Store or found in Chests
- Emote picker will now display the Emotes a player actually owns

[b]Leaderboards and Weekly Rewards[/b]
- Greatly Increased Weekly Rewards! 
- Increased Poker Skill Rating (PSR) Bonuses for playing Higher Stakes

[b]Free Bonus[/b]
- Bonuses are now random and reward approximately 60% more chips than before!
- Increased the chance to find gems in the first four steps of collection
- Free Bonus Chest after 5 collections has greatly increased drops, including more chips, gems, and a chance to find Avatars!

[b]Table Chests[/b]
- Increased the amount of rewards in table chests
- Keep your eye out for special Great Pumpkin table chests!

[b](Re) Introducing Our Avatar Cast[/b]
- The largest update ever to our HD Poker Team of Avatars! 
- A number of Avatars of have been renamed

[b]Name Change Contracts and XP Boosts[/b]
- Players are now no longer limited on the number of name changes and can purchase Name Change Contracts from the Store
- Level up faster and get more rewards by purchasing XP Boost items in the Store or finding them in Chests!

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
+ Many optimizations made to improve performance and quality of life
